profile.name: Agilent/Keysight 33220A 函数/任意波形发生器
profile.description: 这是一款 20 MHz 台式函数/任意波形发生器，可输出常见测试波形并调节频率、相位、占空比、负载与输出极性等参数，常用于电子电路测试、信号激励、教学实验和通用实验室信号源应用。
profile.description_en: This is a 20 MHz benchtop function/arbitrary waveform generator used to produce common test waveforms with adjustable frequency, phase, duty cycle, load setting, and output polarity. It is commonly used for electronic circuit testing, signal stimulation, teaching labs, and general laboratory signal-source applications.
